_about: Skyglass charts (engine/charts.ts) tuned values on top of overrides/hunts.params.json. Keys are live AI ids. commons = the common-chart crew copies (scaled to the player: statsMultiplier `stats`, per id pools/rows); rares = rare-chart stat copies chart-r-*; taintedCopies = tainted pair-fight copies chart-t-*; stats.<Replicant Zero> = its solo edit; echo = Lingering Echo hazard; ember = Burning Deck; steep = Steeping Horror; tainted = tainted twists. Schema floor (insertAiSchema): statsMultiplier >= 1 and poolsMultiplier >= 1; the commons soften through innate rows instead (taken: +damage-taken % rows; givenDown: -damage-given %).
